 🔹3 stolen vehicles
 🔹3,250 rounds of ammo
 🔹62 magazines

This joint effort dealt a serious blow to cartel operations—removing weapons, resources, and mobility from criminal hands.

GANG MEMBER WITH CRIMINAL HISTORY ARRESTED!
On June 5th, USBP agents arrested a notorious Florencia 13 gang member in Pasco, WA. The Mexican national carries a long, violent criminal record-

▪️Robbery
▪️Fentanyl trafficking
▪️Domestic violence
▪️Reckless driving
▪️Disorderly conduct.

AND a final order of removal was issued in March 2025. He faces removal proceedings as an inadmissible alien (8USC1182).

USBP remains relentless in protecting our communities by arresting criminals and enforcing the law.

tweets.text:
SEX OFFENDER ON MOST WANTED LIST ARRESTED!
LANCASTER, NY- 6/5, USBP agents apprehended an individual listed as Puerto Rico's most wanted fugitive who claimed to be a legal resident of the U.S.- even providing a false name and documents in an attempt to deceive. BUT biometrics don't lie.

The truth? He's a Puerto Rican man posing as a Colombian national who presented agents with a fake lawful permanent resident card. That's not all. He's also a convicted sex offender with a long criminal history for kidnapping, weapons possession, threats, aggravated assault, and was listed as Puerto Rico's most wanted fugitive. He now faces felony prosecution for making false statements to federal agents (18USC1001).

Read more:
https://t.co/4kqEpRqGcl

tweets.text:
ILLEGAL ALIEN SENTENCED TO PRISON FOR ASSAULTING USBP AGENT!
Rio Grande City, TX- Salvadoran national, Oscar Sanchez-Rivera, just learned that putting hands on a Border Patrol agent comes with a price. Sanchez-Rivera was sentenced to 36 months in jail for the violent assault.

In November, as the agent opened the door to his vehicle, Sanchez-Rivera lunged at the agent, grabbed his hand, and punched him- breaking his index finger and causing minor injury to the jaw.

Let this be a warning: You attack our agents; you will be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law.
DON'T DO IT!
